replies.body: Yes, this approach works and is better! I can see the elasticsearch-transport-6.0 module already uses this exact pattern. It's more maintainable since it automatically creates stable semconv variants for all test suites without manual duplication. I'll refactor to use this approach.
Done in 4b64acc8. The refactored code uses the map-based pattern and is much cleaner - reduced from ~40 lines to ~15 lines while maintaining the same functionality.
